scope.purpose: Compact, outcome-independent representations of composition and explicit food identity. No task-specific export or predictive benefit is asserted.
scope.public_schema_read: USDA Supporting Data 2022-10-28, nutrient.csv only, inspected in memory for identifier verification.
scope.public_document_access: Primary-source web pages, reports and the static USDA schema archive; no agents or model calls.
scope.coverage: Dependencies present in the five-food dictionary do not establish evidence or completeness across 7405 foods. No food-level values or original names were inspected for this proposal.

usda_foundation.title: USDA FoodData Central Foundation Foods Documentation
usda_foundation.supports: Nutrient definitions, isomer distinctions, reporting basis, portion scaling, energy conventions and quantification limits.

usda_schema.title: USDA FoodData Central Supporting Data, October 2022; nutrient.csv
usda_schema.supports: FDC nutrient IDs and units; specifically 1316 is PUFA 18:2 n-6 c,c and 1404 is PUFA 18:3 n-3 c,c,c (ALA). IDs are not legacy nutrient numbers or food FDC IDs.

fao_protein.title: FAO Food and Nutrition Paper 92: Dietary protein quality evaluation in human nutrition (2013)
fao_protein.supports: Amino-acid analysis and indispensable amino-acid concepts; protein-quality scoring additionally requires digestibility and a reference pattern.

fao_analysis.title: FAO Food Composition Data, Chapter 7: Review of methods of analysis
fao_analysis.supports: Method-dependent amino-acid recovery and interpretation of food composition assays.

fao_quality.title: FAO/INFOODS Guidelines for Checking Food Composition Data, version 1.0 (2012)
fao_quality.supports: Check component sums and definitions; hydrated amino-acid mass is not interchangeable with nitrogen-derived protein; fatty-acid coverage must be specified.

fao_expression.title: FAO Food Composition Data, Chapter 9: Conventions and modes of expression
fao_expression.supports: Explicit units and denominators; preserve missing, trace, calculated and imputed provenance.

fao_description.title: FAO Quality and Accessibility of Food-Related Data: food description systems
fao_description.supports: Independent food-description facets such as source, anatomical part, physical form, preservation and packing medium. Proposed extraction rules are local design choices.

langual_packing.title: LanguaL thesaurus, facet K: Packing Medium
langual_packing.supports: Packing medium is an explicit descriptive facet; the facet heading itself is not a specific indexing term.

retained_existing_formulas.note: Nine specified indispensable amino acids; retain definition without adding another total under a synonym.
Existing definition includes tryptophan, phenylalanine and tyrosine. The proposed phenylalanine-plus-tyrosine pair is distinct.
Reported methionine plus cystine mass. Cystine is not silently renamed cysteine or converted into moles or sulfur mass.
Specified EPA, DHA and n-3 DPA only; not all omega-3 fatty acids.
Reported MUFA plus PUFA; preserve source isomer coverage.
Retain the mass ratio; do not add a molar rescaling or reciprocal as a new feature.
Retain; a saturated share of SFA+MUFA+PUFA would be a one-to-one transform and is not proposed.

formula_contract.binding: Every numeric proposal inherits all rules below. Its policy references and additional caveats are mandatory parts of its definition.
formula_contract.notation: x[ID] is the numeric amount in nutrient_catalog[ID].unit per 100 g edible food in the stated consumed state. Expressions use only numeric constants, indexed x, addition, subtraction, multiplication and division. Constants such as 100 in 100-x[1051] carry g per 100 g food; 100 in an energy-density multiplier sets the reporting basis.
formula_contract.basis_checks: Require aligned edible portions, water basis, preparation state, methods and donor lineage. Normalize mg/g/ug explicitly before evaluation; never identify a quantity by unit alone. Per-100-mL inputs require an evidenced density conversion. No mixing dry-basis inputs into wet-basis formulas.
formula_contract.input_provenance: Preserve each nutrient ID, original unit and basis, public-source record/version, donor, method, transfer or estimate status, detection/quantification limit and any interval. Mixed donors require a documented compatible reconstruction; otherwise return null with incompatible_lineage.
formula_contract.numeric_information_class: All numeric proposals are algebraic transforms of declared inputs. They add no measured information conditional on those inputs; additional analytes must be acquired separately. Group selection is a design choice, not evidence of predictive efficacy.

unknown_policy.rule: Any missing, nonfinite, negative, invalid-basis or incompatible required input makes the point value null. Missing IDs are recorded. Do not zero-fill or treat a partial sum as the full feature. A separately labelled observed-component subtotal may exist only as QC, not this predictor.
unknown_policy.zero: Accept documented numerical zero with its provenance. Do not infer zero from food family, donor absence or an unstated descriptor. A reported rounded zero need not be an exact biological zero.
unknown_policy.censoring: If a zero encodes <LOQ or trace, carry an interval [0,LOQ] where known and leave the point estimate null unless a separately approved estimation rule supplies it. Missing LOQ remains unknown. No automatic LOQ/2 substitution.
unknown_policy.estimates: Existing documented estimates may be transformed but remain estimates. This proposal introduces no imputation algorithm.

denominator_policy.rule: For every ratio, fraction and density, denominator <= 0 returns null; distinguish zero_denominator from invalid_negative_denominator. This includes 0/0 and positive/0. Do not add epsilon, cap, assign zero or emit Infinity/NaN. Unknown numerator is not rescued by a known zero denominator.
denominator_policy.uncertain_denominator: An interval touching zero makes the ratio uncertainty unbounded or undefined; flag denominator_not_separated_from_zero. Do not invent a numerical stability threshold. Use documented measurement precision or detection limits.

aggregation_policies.additive_dose: For consumed edible mass m_i in g, feature dose is m_i*feature_i/100 in the feature's mass unit. Sum doses over an event or day. A mixture concentration is 100*total_dose/sum(m_i) when total mass > 0.
aggregation_policies.ratio_of_totals: For each required nutrient j compute T_j=sum_i(m_i*x_i[j]/100). Apply the same expression to T rather than x, including a reporting multiplier such as 100 kcal. Never sum or take an unweighted or food-mass-weighted mean of food ratios. A food's undefined ratio does not invalidate an event when its underlying required nutrient amounts are known and the event denominator is positive.
aggregation_policies.nonwater_ratio_of_totals: Compute sum_i(m_i*x_i[1003]/100) divided by sum_i(m_i*(100-x_i[1051])/100). The constant 100 is food-specific before summation; do not replace it by 100 at event level.
aggregation_policies.completeness: An unknown required input for any positive-mass item makes the full-event feature null. Also report covered mass and missing IDs as QC. Exclude known zero-mass items before checking nutrient missingness. Unknown or negative portion mass invalidates aggregation. An empty event has zero additive dose but undefined ratios and concentrations.
aggregation_policies.recipes: Linear scaling assumes the represented food state is actually consumed. Ingredient-to-cooked-recipe transfer additionally requires evidenced yield, retention, added water/fat and losses. Do not infer cooking losses from these formulas.
aggregation_policies.scope: These are aggregation semantics for eventual use; no event, disease or task-specific dataset is produced here.

uncertainty_policies.shared: Retain all input uncertainty and transfer/proxy flags, including the dictionary's unvalidated amino-acid proxy. Do not invent confidence scores, standard errors or independence. Missing uncertainty is unknown, not zero variance. Repeat uses of a donor share systematic uncertainty.
uncertainty_policies.linear_sum: If covariance Sigma is known, Var(sum a_j*x_j)=a^T*Sigma*a. Otherwise report uncertainty_not_quantified; valid component bounds may be added for a conservative bound. Do not assume independent analytes from the same food.
uncertainty_policies.ratio: With a positive denominator and justified covariance, propagate with gradient g: Var(f) approximately g^T*Sigma*g, or use matched joint draws. Numerator and denominator often share analytes; preserve that dependence. Without covariance, use justified conservative bounds or uncertainty_not_quantified.
uncertainty_policies.bounded_fraction: Use the ratio policy and structural subset constraints. A fraction outside [0,1] is null with component_total_inconsistency, retaining raw inputs for review. Never clip values or silently renormalize a partial panel.
uncertainty_policies.nonwater: Use the ratio policy including water uncertainty. Near 100 g water per 100 g food the denominator is unstable. The complement of water is operational nonwater mass, not necessarily laboratory dry matter for volatile-rich foods.

formula_contract.rounding: Calculate using available source precision; round only for display. Preserve units and source precision rather than implying extra analytical accuracy.

numeric_proposals.definition: Reported phenylalanine plus tyrosine mass; a specified nutritional pair excluding tryptophan.
numeric_proposals.caveat: Distinct from the retained three-component aromatic sum. This pair alone is not an amino-acid score, digestibility estimate or requirement adequacy measure.

numeric_proposals.definition: Sum of the three named amino acids commonly grouped by basic side-chain chemistry.
numeric_proposals.caveat: Grouping is an explicit design choice. Mass does not measure electrical charge, food pH, buffering or absorbed amino acids; side-chain protonation depends on conditions.

numeric_proposals.definition: Sum of reported aspartic-acid and glutamic-acid quantities under their source analytical convention.
numeric_proposals.caveat: Hydrolysis can convert asparagine and glutamine to their acids. This is not free glutamate, added MSG, an amide-specific measurement or an acid-load score. Do not add separate amide values without method reconciliation.

numeric_proposals.definition: Nine indispensable amino acids divided by the fixed 18-analyte panel, all as reported mass.
numeric_proposals.caveat: Panel-specific mass fraction, not a fraction of all amino acids, residue count, protein purity or protein quality. The panel excludes separately resolved amides and hydroxyproline. Do not export its denominator under a total-protein alias.

numeric_proposals.definition: Isoleucine, leucine and valine mass divided by the fixed nine-indispensable-amino-acid sum.
numeric_proposals.caveat: Reuses two retained sums without re-exporting them. A food-pattern descriptor with no metabolic, circulating-concentration or adequacy interpretation.
Exact chain list avoids disputed chain-length class boundaries. Excludes acetate and propionate; does not measure free acids or microbial SCFA production.
An explicit chain subset; not MCT oil or triglyceride mass, and no shared absorption behavior is assumed for these chains.
Excludes odd-chain and other saturated fatty acids. Does not equal total SFA or a weighted disease-effect index.

numeric_proposals.definition: Reported total polyunsaturated divided by total monounsaturated fatty-acid mass.
numeric_proposals.caveat: Describes the unsaturated pool split, distinct from retained unsaturated/SFA. No assumption that reported totals exclude trans isomers; retain method coverage.

numeric_proposals.definition: EPA, DHA and n-3 DPA mass divided by a reported PUFA total that includes those analytes.
numeric_proposals.caveat: Require confirmation that the source PUFA definition covers the numerator; otherwise null with unverified_component_scope. Excludes ALA and other n-3 species; not an omega-3 index in blood or a total-lipid fraction.

numeric_proposals.definition: Elemental calcium mass divided by elemental phosphorus mass.
numeric_proposals.caveat: A composition ratio only. Does not quantify phosphate salts, intestinal absorption, mineral balance, an ideal dietary target or clinical effect.

numeric_proposals.definition: Reported total dietary fiber divided by carbohydrate by difference.
numeric_proposals.caveat: Carbohydrate by difference is not an independently resolved chemical total. Values >1 receive component_total_inconsistency and are withheld from modeling pending review; preserve the raw diagnostic ratio, never clip. Not fermentable fiber fraction or glycemic response.

numeric_proposals.definition: USDA 2000 total sugars divided by carbohydrate by difference, with source analytical definitions preserved.
numeric_proposals.caveat: Not added sugar, free sugar or sweetness. Values >1 are withheld with component_total_inconsistency while the raw diagnostic ratio is preserved. Do not silently substitute a differently defined sugars ID such as total sugars by summation.

numeric_proposals.definition: Reported protein divided by the complement of water mass in 100 g edible food.
numeric_proposals.caveat: Require 0 <= water <= 100. Protein greater than nonwater mass is withheld as inconsistent. Avoid the label dry-matter protein because water subtraction need not match drying losses; protein retains its nitrogen-factor convention.

numeric_proposals.definition: Alpha-carotene, beta-carotene, beta-cryptoxanthin, lycopene, lutein and zeaxanthin mass; five USDA fields represent six named compounds.
numeric_proposals.caveat: Not all carotenoids, retinol activity equivalents or antioxidant capacity. Count the combined lutein-plus-zeaxanthin field once; never also add its separately resolved components.

numeric_proposals.definition: Dietary fiber mass per 100 kcal of the explicitly selected USDA 1008 energy quantity.
numeric_proposals.caveat: 100 kcal is a reporting denominator, not an intake recommendation or daily value. No 4/4/9 recalculation. Foundation Foods 2047/2048 energy conventions require a separately versioned mapping; they do not silently replace missing 1008.

numeric_proposals.definition: 18:2 n-6 cis,cis linoleic acid divided by 18:3 n-3 cis,cis,cis alpha-linolenic acid.
numeric_proposals.caveat: Never substitute undifferentiated 18:2 (1269) or total 18:3 (1270). This two-analyte ratio is not total n-6/n-3 and has no prescribed optimal value here.

numeric_proposals.definition: The four explicitly identified n-3 species ALA, EPA, DHA and n-3 DPA, summed as fatty-acid mass.
numeric_proposals.caveat: Adds specifically identified ALA to the retained three-species sum. Excludes other n-3 species; not total omega-3, EPA-equivalent dose or a conversion-weighted effect. Adding measured ALA would expand source information, but summation itself does not.

descriptor_contract.binding: All eight descriptor proposals inherit this contract; they are schemas and extraction rules, not populated food annotations.
descriptor_contract.allowed_inputs: Only allowlisted original Hebrew/English food-name or description fields and food ID for joining. No old generated name, donor label, nutrient value or inferred ingredient list.
descriptor_contract.extraction: Deterministic matching using a versioned reviewed bilingual lexicon, Unicode normalization and token boundaries. Keep original text and character spans. Apply explicit negation and phrase scope; distinguish a product's property from an ingredient or serving suggestion. Do not infer a facet from a dish stereotype. The lexicon and multilingual parser still need implementation and review.
descriptor_contract.unknown: No explicit evidence gives null with not_stated, never false or absent. Unsupported terms give null with unrecognized_term; incompatible statements give null with conflict. Explicit negatives remain claims, not measured zeros.
descriptor_contract.sets: Return sorted unique values when multiple terms are explicitly supported. Their order does not imply ingredient order or proportion. Unknown is not an empty set. An explicit single absence claim is retained as a named claim.
descriptor_contract.aggregation: Keep descriptors attached to food identities. Optional event summaries can report consumed food grams bearing each explicitly documented descriptor plus unknown-description grams, or a grams-weighted mean of a numeric text claim among explicitly labelled foods with coverage. Such summaries are not ingredient doses, nutrient intake or proof of absence. No event export is part of this proposal.
descriptor_contract.uncertainty: Uncertainty concerns the name's completeness, language, ambiguity and claim accuracy. Preserve supporting spans and conflict status; no invented numeric confidence. Even an explicit label is not laboratory verification.
descriptor_contract.no_redundant_facets: Retain existing family, preparation, fermentation and grain-refinement columns. Add only the independent facets below; overlapping evidence spans do not justify duplicating the existing features under new names.

original_name_descriptor_proposals.definition: Organisms explicitly named as food sources or ingredients, at the precision actually stated.
original_name_descriptor_proposals.extraction_rule: Map explicit common names through a reviewed lexicon. Do not assign a Latin species when the common name is broader; do not infer the source of an unnamed oil or milk.
original_name_descriptor_proposals.caveat: A named organism is not a complete recipe, botanical verification, ingredient fraction or allergen absence statement.

original_name_descriptor_proposals.definition: Explicit plant or animal parts, such as leaf, seed, root, breast or liver.
original_name_descriptor_proposals.extraction_rule: Match literal part terms and preserve their associated organism when the text supplies one. Do not infer leaf from a vegetable family or muscle from a meat-product name.
original_name_descriptor_proposals.caveat: Part names do not establish edible yield, tissue proportions or nutrient content.

original_name_descriptor_proposals.definition: Physical form explicitly specified in the name or original description.
original_name_descriptor_proposals.extraction_rule: Match form phrases with scope, including powder, liquid, puree, paste, minced, sliced or intact. The phrase whole grain is a refinement statement, not evidence of intact physical form.
original_name_descriptor_proposals.caveat: Does not quantify particle size, texture, viscosity, digestibility or degree of processing.

original_name_descriptor_proposals.definition: Explicitly named preservation treatments, distinct from the existing cooking/preparation facet.
original_name_descriptor_proposals.extraction_rule: Match preservation terms; exclude ordinary cooking and fermentation already covered by retained descriptors. Store several explicitly named treatments without inventing their order.
original_name_descriptor_proposals.caveat: Pickling does not establish fermentation; smoking does not quantify contaminants; canning does not identify packing medium. No NOVA assignment follows from these labels.

original_name_descriptor_proposals.definition: Medium explicitly surrounding the stored or served food.
original_name_descriptor_proposals.extraction_rule: Require a packing or surrounding-medium phrase such as in brine, packed in oil or in syrup. An ingredient mention alone is insufficient.
original_name_descriptor_proposals.caveat: Does not imply the medium was consumed, its mass, or its sugar, salt or fat content. Use the draining facet separately.

original_name_descriptor_proposals.definition: Explicit inclusion or removal of surrounding liquid for the named edible portion.
original_name_descriptor_proposals.extraction_rule: Match explicit drained, undrained or solids-and-liquid wording. Neither canned nor in oil establishes drainage; ambiguous dry wording is insufficient.
original_name_descriptor_proposals.caveat: Useful for portion and donor compatibility, but no numeric drainage factor or retained-medium amount is inferred.

original_name_descriptor_proposals.definition: Literal claims about added ingredients or fortification, with explicit negative statements preserved.
original_name_descriptor_proposals.extraction_rule: Use phrase-level negation and ingredient context. Distinguish no added sugar from sugar free, and salt added from no added salt. Capture fortified only when explicitly stated; never infer the fortificant or its dose.
original_name_descriptor_proposals.caveat: Claims do not establish regulatory compliance or zero total sugar/sodium. Sweetened does not identify a caloric sweetener. Conflicting claims within the same scope remain unresolved.

original_name_descriptor_proposals.definition: A percentage explicitly attached to fat in the original text, preserved as a claim with its stated basis.
original_name_descriptor_proposals.extraction_rule: Parse a locale-aware decimal from an explicit fat-percent phrase, retain exact span and record basis as product_mass, dry_matter, reduction_relative_to_reference or unspecified. Accept only 0 to 100; do not infer a basis from product type. A bare 3% or an ingredient percentage does not qualify.
original_name_descriptor_proposals.aggregation: No arithmetic aggregation across different or unspecified bases. Even a grams-weighted product-mass claim summary remains a label-claim summary, not measured fat intake.
original_name_descriptor_proposals.caveat: Never use this descriptor as a nutrient fallback. Fat-in-dry-matter and percent fat reduction are not g fat per 100 g product; retain their bases or exclude them from a common numeric predictor.

excluded_or_deferred.candidate: disease scores and atherogenic/thrombogenic or inflammatory weighted sums
excluded_or_deferred.reason: Outside food-level scope; no disease-effect weights are invented or imported.

excluded_or_deferred.candidate: nutrient percent daily values or adequacy scores
excluded_or_deferred.reason: Require external reference-person and intake assumptions, not intrinsic food composition.

excluded_or_deferred.candidate: total n-3, total n-6 or n-6/n-3 from undifferentiated fatty acids
excluded_or_deferred.reason: Incomplete isomer coverage cannot establish totals. In particular 1270 is not ALA and 1271 undifferentiated 20:4 is not automatically arachidonic acid.

excluded_or_deferred.candidate: extra saturated fraction or reciprocal unsaturated/SFA ratio
excluded_or_deferred.reason: One-to-one transform of an existing ratio, not a useful separate proposal.

excluded_or_deferred.candidate: kJ energy, IU activity, molar copies and per-serving copies as new predictors
excluded_or_deferred.reason: Unit changes or serving assumptions do not add a distinct compositional quantity.
Hydrolysate and nitrogen-based protein definitions differ; the fixed panel is used only as an explicitly named denominator.

excluded_or_deferred.candidate: carbohydrate minus fiber labelled available or digestible carbohydrate
excluded_or_deferred.reason: Method and component coverage need reconciliation; no new digestibility, net-carb or glycemic claim is made.

excluded_or_deferred.candidate: dietary SCFA sum labelled microbial production; medium-chain FA sum labelled MCT
excluded_or_deferred.reason: These would confuse chemical species, lipid form and biological production.

excluded_or_deferred.candidate: complete NOVA, live-culture dose, ingredients or refined-grain negatives from names
excluded_or_deferred.reason: Original descriptions may be incomplete; absent words do not establish absent properties.

promotion_requirements: Check all required IDs, units, basis and source-component scope against the pinned source release; no joins on display names alone.
Report per-feature evidence coverage over all 7405 foods, separating source-supported, transferred, estimated, censored, unknown and inconsistent cells. Preserve unresolved proposals.

Check exact and semantic duplicates against the current independent Gen2 registry, including future direct-source totals. All sums remain correlated algebraic summaries, not independent chemical measurements.
Verify missing-input propagation, all-zero sums, 0/0, positive/0, near-zero denominators, component-total inconsistencies, different edible bases and missing portions.
Verify event ratios from nutrient totals, including a zero-denominator food inside an event with a valid total denominator, and the special nonwater denominator.

Test bilingual extraction for negation, conflicting phrases, ingredient-versus-product scope, ambiguous percentages and unstated information, using original names only when separately authorized for implementation.
Select among these optional representations without outcome leakage; do not automatically export every algebraically dependent column. No predictive ranking or efficacy validation is claimed here.
